description: This file is a C header (.h) file defining the interface for a subscription retry mechanism in a system that handles NotifyRequest messages. It declares function prototypes for initializing, stopping, adding, and removing retry entries, and contains macro definitions and include directives relevant to subscription retries.

methods.name: SUBS_RETRY_Add
methods.description: Adds a subscription retry entry with specified parameters.

methods.name: SUBS_RETRY_AddWithFds
methods.description: Adds a subscription retry entry with file descriptor passing, conditionally compiled.

methods.name: SUBS_RETRY_Remove
methods.description: Removes a retry entry based on message and subscription IDs.

methods.name: SUBS_RETRY_Delete
methods.description: Deletes a retry entry based on its instance number.
